project.title: Clinic Retail Corner and Supply Shelf Optimisation
project.objective: Design and roll out a standardised layout and process for clinic retail and medical supply shelves to improve safety, stock accuracy, and patient experience.
deliverables: Standard shelf layout plan for retail and medical supplies
Restocking and rotation procedure for all shifts
Labelling and pricing guideline for products and supplies
Daily and weekly shelf inspection checklist
Training session and quick-reference guide for staff
Post-rollout review report with improvement actions
constraints: Must comply with health, safety, and hygiene regulations for medical and food products
No major store refit; only layout and process changes within existing fixtures
Minimal disruption to patient flow and appointment schedules
All changes must be easy to follow for rotating and part-time staff
Price and label changes must match existing billing and POS rules
Project must be completed within the agreed timebox

risks.risk: Non-compliance with hygiene or medical storage rules during changes
risks.mitigation: Health and safety officer to review layout and procedures before rollout and after first week.

risks.risk: Stockouts or misplacement during transition to new layout
risks.mitigation: Run transition in phases with temporary maps and double-checks on critical items.

risks.risk: Staff confusion about new labelling and rotation rules
risks.mitigation: Provide short training, visual guides on shelves, and a feedback loop in the first two weeks.

risks.risk: Price discrepancies between shelf labels and billing system
risks.mitigation: Cross-check label changes with finance and billing coordinator before printing and applying.

themes.why_relevant: Clear zones reduce search time, errors, and improve patient and customer experience.
Essential to avoid expired medical and food products and reduce waste.
Prevents price disputes and billing errors for patients and customers.
Critical for medical and food products to meet regulatory and internal standards.
Ensures all shifts apply the new process consistently over time.
Post-rollout checks help refine layout and procedures based on real use.

backlog.task: Map current shelf layouts for retail and medical supplies
definition_of_done: All existing shelves photographed or sketched
List of product categories per shelf documented
Pain points from staff noted in brief comments

backlog.task: Design new standardised shelf layout and zoning
definition_of_done: Proposed layout documented with zones and key items
Critical items placed for quick access and safety
Layout reviewed with doctors' surgery assistant and store manager

backlog.task: Define stock rotation and expiry-check procedure
definition_of_done: Rotation steps written for daily and weekly routines
Responsibilities per shift clarified
Procedure validated by health and safety officer

backlog.task: Create labelling and pricing guideline aligned with billing rules
definition_of_done: Label format and content defined
Process for updating prices documented
Finance and billing coordinator signs off on guideline

backlog.task: Draft daily and weekly shelf inspection checklist
definition_of_done: Checklist items cover hygiene, stock level, expiry, and labelling
Separate sections for retail and medical supplies
Checklist tested for one day and adjusted if needed

backlog.task: Plan and execute physical relayout of shelves
definition_of_done: Shelves rearranged according to approved layout
Old labels removed and new ones applied
Spot-check confirms items match layout plan

backlog.task: Validate medical supply storage against clinical requirements
definition_of_done: Temperature and access requirements checked
High-risk items stored according to protocol
Health and safety officer confirms compliance

backlog.task: Prepare quick-reference training guide for staff
definition_of_done: One-page visual guide created for each main zone
Rotation and labelling basics summarised
Guide shared in print near staff area and digitally

backlog.task: Run short training huddles for all shifts
definition_of_done: Training slots scheduled to cover all regular staff
Attendance recorded for each session
Key questions and issues captured for follow-up

backlog.task: Set up simple tracking of stock issues after rollout
definition_of_done: Log format defined for stockouts, misplacements, and expiry finds
Team knows how to record issues
First week of data collected

backlog.task: Conduct post-rollout review and propose adjustments
definition_of_done: Feedback from staff and stakeholders collected
Issue log analysed for patterns
List of agreed layout or process tweaks documented

backlog.task: Align shelf changes with appointment and patient flow
definition_of_done: Check that high-use clinical items are near treatment areas
Confirm no new bottlenecks in patient movement
Adjustments agreed with store manager if needed

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on project scope, roles, and initial mapping of current shelves
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the shelf optimisation project and asking for input on current pain points.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on final list of shelves and zones to include in the project scope.
Confirm who owns updating the layout map and by when.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on the new standard shelf layout and zoning
threads_plan.trigger: Share first draft of the proposed layout map and request feedback from clinical and store perspectives.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the standard layout for retail shelves.
Approve the standard layout for medical supply shelves with clinical sign-off.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and finalise rotation, expiry, and inspection procedures
threads_plan.trigger: Post initial draft of rotation procedure and inspection checklist for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Lock in the rotation and expiry-check frequency for each product category.
Approve the final version of the daily and weekly inspection checklist.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align labelling, pricing, and training approach before relayout
threads_plan.trigger: Share labelling guideline and training plan ahead of physical shelf changes.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the labelling and pricing guideline for rollout.
Agree on training format and dates for all shifts.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Monitor rollout, capture issues, and agree on follow-up improvements
threads_plan.trigger: Start of rollout week with request to log issues and share quick observations.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on final list of shelves and zones to include in the project scope.
Approve the final version of the daily and weekly inspection checklist.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in on shelf issues and quick wins
Weekly summary post on stock incidents and layout feedback
Pre-rollout go/no-go check the day before physical changes
Post-rollout review thread after first full week
Ad-hoc micro-updates when a new guideline or checklist version is published
